name: Crayanne
source:
One of the dryad twins living in a forest near Yuidora, and Crayl's sister.
When Crayl leaves to adventuring with Will, Crayanne stays behind to protect their forest. After realizing that they will have to part due to the dryads' nature, she runs away, but is captured by a wandering alchemist. After Will and Crayl rescue her, she decides to stay with them.
